title: CoT Scratchpad Truncation as a Monitor Evasion Vector: Measuring Detectability Loss

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If 'think briefly' instructions reliably evade monitors, any deployment using conciseness instructions (very common) undermines CoT monitoring. This is an immediately actionable finding for deployment guidelines.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Two prompting conditions on the same tasks, then applying a prompted monitor to both. Entirely API-based. No model training or GPU needed. Extremely simple for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two conditions (normal vs minimized CoT), one dataset, one metric (AUROC drop). Minimal setup. Easily completed in under 30 hours.
